description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal plugin class 'FilterFormatPermission' used for migrating filter format permissions from Drupal 6. It converts serial filter format data into string permission names during migration, and is deprecated in Drupal 11.3.0.

classes.name: FilterFormatPermission
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class for converting filter format serials to string IDs in permission names, deprecated in Drupal 11.3.0.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the FilterFormatPermission plugin, initializes migration and lookup services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependency injection.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms source filter format data into permission strings during migration.
